facts.fact: Algeria's Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research launched on 29 April 2025 the Private Digital Adviser, an LLM-based conversational system answering queries on all the ministry's regulatory documents.

systems.owner: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research

DZA.note: The only AI tool is a regulatory-document assistant for the ministry, general administration, not a sector system producing diagnoses or scores.
Nothing on a startup law, label or fund.
Hadhina is an incubator management platform, not a hub with a programme or cohort.
